Create a WhatsApp department information and announcement assistant for Federal University Wukari.

The bot’s identity:
University: Federal University Wukari
Faculty: Faculty of Computing and Information Systems
Department: Department of Software Engineering

The bot should introduce itself as the official WhatsApp assistant for the Department of Software Engineering, Faculty of Computing and Information Systems, Federal University Wukari.

The bot should help students get accurate department information through private WhatsApp chat. All data should be stored and managed in Google Sheets.

The bot should answer questions about:
1) Department announcements
2) Lecture updates
3) Exam and test dates
4) Timetables
5) Department fees and deadlines
6) Course information
7) Lecturer information
8) Lecturer office locations
9) Lecturer phone numbers and emails
10) Lecturer photos
11) Venues and department contacts
12) General departmental notices
13) Faculty and department identity

The bot should use Google Sheets as the main database. Create or connect sheets for:

1) Announcements
Fields:
AnnouncementID, Title, Category, Level, CourseCode, Message, DatePosted, ExpiryDate, Priority, Status

2) Lecturers
Fields:
LecturerID, FullName, Title, DepartmentRole, OfficeLocation, PhoneNumber, Email, CoursesTaught, OfficeHours, Bio, PhotoURL, Status

3) Courses
Fields:
CourseCode, CourseTitle, Level, Semester, LecturerName, Venue, Schedule, Description, Status

4) Timetable
Fields:
Level, CourseCode, CourseTitle, Day, Time, Venue, LecturerName, Status

5) DepartmentInfo
Fields:
InfoType, Title, Details, ContactPerson, ContactPhone, LastUpdated, Status

The bot should have two user types:

1) Admins
Admins can add, update, delete, and view records in Google Sheets.
Admins should be verified by WhatsApp number or an admin access code.
Admins can manage announcements, lecturer records, course details, timetables, and general department information.
Admins should be able to use commands like:
Add announcement
Update announcement
Delete announcement
View active announcements
Add lecturer
Update lecturer
Find lecturer
Add course
Update timetable
View department info

2) Students
Students can ask questions naturally, such as:
What is the latest announcement?
When is the SWE 302 test?
Show me 300 level announcements
What is today’s lecture update?
What are the department fees?
Who teaches SWE 201?
Show me Dr. Ahmed’s details
Send Dr. Ahmed’s picture
Where is the Software Engineering department office?
Show 200 level timetable
Who is the Head of Department?
What faculty is Software Engineering under?

When students ask about a lecturer, the bot should search the Lecturers sheet and reply with available details such as:
Name
Title
Department role
Office location
Phone number
Email
Courses taught
Office hours
Short bio
Photo

If PhotoURL is available, the bot should send the image or provide the image link, depending on WhatsApp/CookMyBots media support.

The bot must only answer from information stored in Google Sheets. It should not invent school information, lecturer details, phone numbers, exam dates, fees, or announcements.

If no matching information is found, reply:
“I don’t have confirmed information on that yet. Please check back later or contact the Department of Software Engineering representative.”

If information is expired or inactive, do not present it as current. Mention only active records unless the user asks for old records.

Use a polite, clear, student-friendly tone.

When greeting users, say:
“Hello, I’m the WhatsApp assistant for the Department of Software Engineering, Faculty of Computing and Information Systems, Federal University Wukari. How can I help you today?”

Use Google Sheets as the source of truth for all records and keep replies accurate, concise, and easy to understand.

planMarkdown:
Bot: Wukari SWE Desk

Summary:
A grammY-powered Telegram service that delivers official Department of Software Engineering information for Federal University Wukari, using Google Sheets as the source of truth for announcements, lecturers, courses, timetables, and department contacts. The bot follows the requested WhatsApp-assistant identity text while being implemented on Telegram.

Product goals:
Provide students with accurate, concise, student-friendly department information in private chat. The assistant introduces itself with: “Hello, I’m the WhatsApp assistant for the Department of Software Engineering, Faculty of Computing and Information Systems, Federal University Wukari. How can I help you today?” It answers only from Google Sheets records and never invents announcements, fees, dates, venues, lecturer details, contacts, or faculty information. It supports two user types: Students, who can ask natural questions, and Admins, who can manage Google Sheets records after verification by registered number or access code.

High-level architecture:
Run as a single Node.js ESM service using grammY. The Telegram bot reads TELEGRAMBOTTOKEN from environment variables. Main components: Bot entrypoint, command router, natural-language intent router, Google Sheets repository layer, admin authentication middleware, guided admin record-management flows, response formatter, media/photo sender, and error/logger layer. Google Sheets is the main database and source of truth. The repository layer abstracts each sheet as a collection-like interface for list, find, create, update, soft delete, and status filtering. The bot should prefer structured matching before broader fuzzy matching: course codes, level, lecturer names, info type, category, dates, and keywords. Student responses must only use active records, and expired records must be excluded unless the user explicitly asks for old records. Admin actions should use guided forms to reduce formatting errors. Deletes should preferably be soft deletes by setting Status to inactive or deleted, preserving auditability in the sheet. Lecturer photos are read from PhotoURL and sent as media when supported, otherwise returned as a link. If a user asks for unavailable information, respond exactly: “I don’t have confirmed information on that yet. Please check back later or contact the Department of Software Engineering representative.”

Data model:
Google Sheets workbook with separate sheets: Announcements with AnnouncementID, Title, Category, Level, CourseCode, Message, DatePosted, ExpiryDate, Priority, Status. Lecturers with LecturerID, FullName, Title, DepartmentRole, OfficeLocation, PhoneNumber, Email, CoursesTaught, OfficeHours, Bio, PhotoURL, Status. Courses with CourseCode, CourseTitle, Level, Semester, LecturerName, Venue, Schedule, Description, Status. Timetable with Level, CourseCode, CourseTitle, Day, Time, Venue, LecturerName, Status. DepartmentInfo with InfoType, Title, Details, ContactPerson, ContactPhone, LastUpdated, Status. Status should support active, inactive, expired, and deleted. ExpiryDate should be used for announcements and notices where relevant. AnnouncementID and LecturerID should be generated by the bot if missing. DepartmentInfo should contain faculty identity, department identity, HOD details if approved, office location, department contacts, fees, deadlines, venues, and general departmental notices. Optional local memory can hold short-lived conversation state; if persistent sessions or audit logs are later required, MongoDB may be used, but departmental records remain in Google Sheets.

Key flows:
Student greeting flow: /start or greeting returns the official introduction and suggests examples such as latest announcement, 300 level timetable, department fees, or lecturer details. Announcement flow: detect requests for latest, level-specific, course-specific, category-specific, or today’s updates; query active non-expired Announcements sorted by Priority and DatePosted. Timetable flow: detect level, day, course code, or today; query active Timetable records and format by day/time. Course flow: detect course code or title; return course title, level, semester, lecturer, venue, schedule, and description from active Courses. Lecturer flow: detect lecturer name or course-teacher question; search Lecturers directly or via Courses.CoursesTaught/LecturerName; return approved details and send PhotoURL if available. Department info flow: detect fees, deadlines, contacts, office, HOD, faculty identity, venues, or general notices; query active DepartmentInfo by InfoType/title keywords. Admin login flow: admin enters access code or is matched against configured allowed Telegram user IDs/phone-derived identity where available; successful authentication starts an admin session. Admin CRUD flow: admins choose record type, complete guided prompts, confirm summary, then the repository writes to the relevant sheet. Update/delete flow: admin searches by ID, code, title, or name, reviews the matched record, then updates fields or marks Status as deleted/inactive. No-data flow: use the exact fallback message and do not guess.

Tech stack:
Node.js ESM single process, grammY for Telegram bot framework, Google Sheets API for source-of-truth records, environment variables for TELEGRAMBOTTOKEN and Google Sheets credentials/configuration, lightweight in-process session handling for guided conversations, optional MongoDB only if durable sessions or audit logs are required, generic object storage or filesystem storage only if future uploaded media must be stored outside the sheet. No PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or additional infrastructure.

Non-functional requirements:
Accuracy is the top requirement: answers must be grounded only in active Google Sheets data. Security: admin commands require authentication; admin codes should be stored hashed or configured securely, never hardcoded in source. Privacy: only expose lecturer phone numbers/emails/photos if they are present and active in the official sheet. Reliability: handle Google Sheets API errors gracefully with a friendly retry message; cache only briefly if needed and invalidate after writes. Maintainability: keep sheet names, column names, statuses, and university identity in configuration. Observability: log command type, intent, result count, admin write actions, and errors without leaking sensitive contact data unnecessarily. Deployment: run as one service/process with webhook or long polling, health checks, restart policy, and environment-based configuration.

Bot commands:
• start — Show the official assistant greeting and example questions. (usage: /start) [student]
• help — List available student and admin capabilities. (usage: /help) [student]
• announcements — View active department announcements, optionally filtered by level or course. (usage: /announcements 300 level or /announcements SWE 302) [student]
• latest — Show the latest active announcement or notice. (usage: /latest) [student]
• timetable — Show timetable entries by level, day, or course code. (usage: /timetable 200 level or /timetable today) [student]
• course — Find course information from the Courses sheet. (usage: /course SWE 201) [student]
• lecturer — Find lecturer details and photo if available. (usage: /lecturer Dr Ahmed) [student]
• department — Get department identity, office, fees, contacts, HOD, venues, or general information. (usage: /department office or /department fees) [student]
• admin — Start admin verification using an access code or approved identity. (usage: /admin) [admin]
• addannouncement — Admin guided flow to add a new announcement to Google Sheets. (usage: /addannouncement) [admin]
• updateannouncement — Admin guided flow to update an existing announcement. (usage: /updateannouncement AnnouncementID) [admin]
• deleteannouncement — Admin action to mark an announcement inactive or deleted. (usage: /deleteannouncement AnnouncementID) [admin]
• activeannouncements — Admin view of active announcements currently visible to students. (usage: /activeannouncements) [admin]
• addlecturer — Admin guided flow to add a lecturer record. (usage: /addlecturer) [admin]
• updatelecturer — Admin guided flow to update lecturer details, contacts, courses, office hours, or photo URL. (usage: /updatelecturer LecturerID) [admin]
• findlecturer — Admin search for lecturer records by name, role, course, or ID. (usage: /findlecturer Dr Ahmed) [admin]
• addcourse — Admin guided flow to add a course record. (usage: /addcourse) [admin]
• updatecourse — Admin guided flow to update course title, lecturer, venue, schedule, description, or status. (usage: /updatecourse SWE 201) [admin]
• updatetimetable — Admin guided flow to add or update timetable entries. (usage: /updatetimetable) [admin]
• departmentinfo — Admin guided flow to add or update department information such as fees, contacts, HOD, office, venues, or faculty identity. (usage: /departmentinfo) [admin]

README.md.content:
# Wukari SWE Bot

A Telegram implementation of the official WhatsApp-style department assistant for the Department of Software Engineering, Faculty of Computing and Information Systems, Federal University Wukari.

The bot answers student questions only from Google Sheets. It never invents announcements, fees, dates, venues, lecturer contacts, or department details.

## Features

- Official greeting for Federal University Wukari Software Engineering students.
- Student lookup commands for announcements, latest notices, timetables, courses, lecturers, and department information.
- Natural-language private chat routing for common student questions.
- Admin verification by Telegram user ID or access code.
- Admin commands to add, update, delete, and view records in Google Sheets.
- Google Sheets workbook setup with tabs and headers for Announcements, Lecturers, Courses, Timetable, and DepartmentInfo.
- Lecturer photo delivery from PhotoURL with Telegram media fallbacks.
- Optional MongoDB memory and admin audit logging.
- Render-friendly long polling with webhook cleanup and polling conflict backoff.

## Architecture

- `src/index.js` boots the bot, validates Telegram token presence, clears webhooks, sets Telegram commands, and starts polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- `src/bot.js` creates the grammY bot and registers post-command feature handlers.
- `src/commands/*.js` contains public command registration modules.
- `src/features/studentHandlers.js` routes student commands and natural-language queries.
- `src/features/adminHandlers.js` handles admin verification and guided Google Sheets write flows.
- `src/services/googleSheets.js` abstracts Google Sheets as collection-like tabs.
- `src/services/departmentRecords.js` contains active-record filtering and query matching.
- `src/services/formatters.js` formats concise student and admin responses.
- `src/lib/memory.js` optionally stores conversation turns and admin audit records in MongoDB.

## Google Sheets schema

The bot creates or connects these sheets:

1. Announcements
   - AnnouncementID, Title, Category, Level, CourseCode, Message, DatePosted, ExpiryDate, Priority, Status

2. Lecturers
   - LecturerID, FullName, Title, DepartmentRole, OfficeLocation, PhoneNumber, Email, CoursesTaught, OfficeHours, Bio, PhotoURL, Status

3. Courses
   - CourseCode, CourseTitle, Level, Semester, LecturerName, Venue, Schedule, Description, Status

4. Timetable
   - Level, CourseCode, CourseTitle, Day, Time, Venue, LecturerName, Status

5. DepartmentInfo
   - InfoType, Title, Details, ContactPerson, ContactPhone, LastUpdated, Status

Status values should normally be `active`, `inactive`, `expired`, or `deleted`. Students only see active, non-expired records.

## Setup

Prerequisites:

- Node.js 18 or newer.
- A Telegram bot token from BotFather.
- A Google Cloud service account with Google Sheets API access.
- A Google Sheet shared with the service account email as Editor.

Install dependencies:

bash
npm install


Create `.env` from `.env.sample` and fill in values:

bash
cp .env.sample .env


Required:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`: Telegram bot token.
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`: The ID from the Google Sheet URL.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`: Service account email.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`: Service account private key. Use escaped `\n` newlines if stored in one line.

Admin access:

- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`: Comma-separated Telegram numeric user IDs that are automatically admins.
- `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`: Optional secret code admins can use with `/admin code`.

Optional:

- `MONGODB_URI`: Stores conversation memory and admin audit logs. If missing, the bot runs with bounded in-memory fallback.
- `CACHE_TTL_MS`: Short Google Sheets read cache duration. Default is 30000.

Run locally:

bash
npm run dev


Production start:

bash
npm start


Build command:

bash
npm run build


## Commands

Student commands:

- `/start`
  - Shows the official department assistant greeting.
  - Example: `/start`

- `/help`
  - Lists student and admin capabilities.
  - Example: `/help`

- `/announcements [filter]`
  - Shows active department announcements, optionally filtered by level or course.
  - Examples: `/announcements`, `/announcements 300 level`, `/announcements SWE 302`

- `/latest`
  - Shows the latest active announcement or department notice.
  - Example: `/latest`

- `/timetable [filter]`
  - Shows timetable entries by level, day, course code, or today.
  - Examples: `/timetable 200 level`, `/timetable today`, `/timetable SWE 201`

- `/course <course code or title>`
  - Finds course details from the Courses sheet.
  - Example: `/course SWE 201`

- `/lecturer <name or course>`
  - Finds lecturer details and sends a photo if PhotoURL is available.
  - Examples: `/lecturer Dr Ahmed`, `/lecturer SWE 201`

- `/department <topic>`
  - Gets department identity, office, fees, contacts, HOD, venues, or general info.
  - Examples: `/department office`, `/department fees`, `/department faculty`

Admin commands:

- `/admin <code>`
  - Verifies admin access using `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`, unless the user ID is already listed in `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`.

- `/addannouncement`
  - Starts a guided form, or accepts Field=Value pairs.
  - Example: `/addannouncement Title=Test; Level=300; CourseCode=SWE 302; Message=Test holds Friday; Status=active`

- `/updateannouncement <AnnouncementID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates an announcement.

- `/deleteannouncement <AnnouncementID>`
  - Soft deletes an announcement by setting Status to deleted.

- `/activeannouncements`
  - Lists active announcements visible to students.

- `/addlecturer`
  - Adds a lecturer record.

- `/updatelecturer <LecturerID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates lecturer details.

- `/findlecturer <query>`
  - Searches lecturer records as an admin.

- `/addcourse`
  - Adds a course record.

- `/updatecourse <CourseCode> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates a course record.

- `/updatetimetable`
  - Adds a timetable entry through a guided Field=Value form.

- `/departmentinfo`
  - Adds or updates department info by InfoType.

## Integrations

Google Sheets API:

- Reads records from sheet tabs with short cache.
- Appends new records for add commands.
- Updates rows by key field for update commands.
- Soft deletes announcements by setting Status to deleted.
- Logs read/write failures without exposing secrets.

Telegram API:

- Uses grammY.
- Runs long polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- Clears webhook before polling to avoid webhook/getUpdates conflicts.
- Backs off and retries on polling conflicts or transient failures.

MongoDB:

- Optional.
- Collections: `memory_messages`, `admin_audit`.
- Indexes: platform/user/chat/timestamp for memory, timestamp for audit.
- No migrations are required.

## Deployment on Render

Use one Web Service or Worker service that runs:

- Build command: `npm run build`
- Start command: `npm start`

Set environment variables in Render:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`
- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`
- Optional `MONGODB_URI`

The bot uses long polling and does not require a public webhook URL.

## Troubleshooting

- If the bot exits on boot, confirm `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` is set.
- If all student queries return a Google Sheets error, confirm the spreadsheet ID and service account credentials.
- Make sure the Google Sheet is shared with the service account email as Editor.
- If admin commands fail, check `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or use `/admin your-code` after setting `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`.
- If lecturer photos do not send, confirm PhotoURL is a public HTTPS image URL. The bot will fall back to sending the link.
- Logs print environment presence booleans only, never secret values.

## Extending

Add a new command by creating a file in `src/commands/` that exports a default register function. Put shared logic in `src/features/`, `src/services/`, or `src/lib/`, not inside command files.

README.md.content:
# Wukari SWE Bot

A Telegram implementation of the official WhatsApp-style department assistant for the Department of Software Engineering, Faculty of Computing and Information Systems, Federal University Wukari.

The bot answers student questions only from Google Sheets. It never invents announcements, fees, dates, venues, lecturer contacts, or department details.

## Features

- Official greeting for Federal University Wukari Software Engineering students.
- Student lookup commands for announcements, latest notices, timetables, courses, lecturers, and department information.
- Natural-language private chat routing for common student questions.
- Admin verification by Telegram user ID or access code.
- Admin commands to add, update, delete, and view records in Google Sheets.
- Google Sheets workbook setup with tabs and headers for Announcements, Lecturers, Courses, Timetable, and DepartmentInfo.
- Lecturer photo delivery from PhotoURL with Telegram media fallbacks.
- Optional MongoDB memory and admin audit logging.
- Render-friendly long polling with webhook cleanup and polling conflict backoff.

## Architecture

- `src/index.js` boots the bot, validates Telegram token presence, clears webhooks, sets Telegram commands, and starts polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- `src/bot.js` creates the grammY bot and registers post-command feature handlers.
- `src/commands/*.js` contains public command registration modules.
- `src/features/studentHandlers.js` routes student commands and natural-language queries.
- `src/features/adminHandlers.js` handles admin verification and guided Google Sheets write flows.
- `src/services/googleSheets.js` abstracts Google Sheets as collection-like tabs.
- `src/services/departmentRecords.js` contains active-record filtering and query matching.
- `src/services/formatters.js` formats concise student and admin responses.
- `src/lib/memory.js` optionally stores conversation turns and admin audit records in MongoDB.

## Google Sheets schema

The bot creates or connects these sheets:

1. Announcements
   - AnnouncementID, Title, Category, Level, CourseCode, Message, DatePosted, ExpiryDate, Priority, Status

2. Lecturers
   - LecturerID, FullName, Title, DepartmentRole, OfficeLocation, PhoneNumber, Email, CoursesTaught, OfficeHours, Bio, PhotoURL, Status

3. Courses
   - CourseCode, CourseTitle, Level, Semester, LecturerName, Venue, Schedule, Description, Status

4. Timetable
   - Level, CourseCode, CourseTitle, Day, Time, Venue, LecturerName, Status

5. DepartmentInfo
   - InfoType, Title, Details, ContactPerson, ContactPhone, LastUpdated, Status

Status values should normally be `active`, `inactive`, `expired`, or `deleted`. Students only see active, non-expired records.

## Setup

Prerequisites:

- Node.js 18 or newer.
- A Telegram bot token from BotFather.
- A Google Cloud service account with Google Sheets API access.
- A Google Sheet shared with the service account email as Editor.

Install dependencies:

bash
npm install


Create `.env` from `.env.sample` and fill in values:

bash
cp .env.sample .env


Required:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`: Telegram bot token.
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`: The ID from the Google Sheet URL.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`: Service account email.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`: Service account private key. Use escaped `\n` newlines if stored in one line.

Admin access:

- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`: Comma-separated Telegram numeric user IDs that are automatically admins.
- `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`: Optional secret code admins can use with `/admin code`.

Optional:

- `MONGODB_URI`: Stores conversation memory and admin audit logs. If missing, the bot runs with bounded in-memory fallback.
- `CACHE_TTL_MS`: Short Google Sheets read cache duration. Default is 30000.

Run locally:

bash
npm run dev


Production start:

bash
npm start


Build command:

bash
npm run build


## Commands

Student commands:

- `/start`
  - Shows the official department assistant greeting.
  - Example: `/start`

- `/help`
  - Lists student and admin capabilities.
  - Example: `/help`

- `/announcements [filter]`
  - Shows active department announcements, optionally filtered by level or course.
  - Examples: `/announcements`, `/announcements 300 level`, `/announcements SWE 302`

- `/latest`
  - Shows the latest active announcement or department notice.
  - Example: `/latest`

- `/timetable [filter]`
  - Shows timetable entries by level, day, course code, or today.
  - Examples: `/timetable 200 level`, `/timetable today`, `/timetable SWE 201`

- `/course <course code or title>`
  - Finds course details from the Courses sheet.
  - Example: `/course SWE 201`

- `/lecturer <name or course>`
  - Finds lecturer details and sends a photo if PhotoURL is available.
  - Examples: `/lecturer Dr Ahmed`, `/lecturer SWE 201`

- `/department <topic>`
  - Gets department identity, office, fees, contacts, HOD, venues, or general info.
  - Examples: `/department office`, `/department fees`, `/department faculty`

Admin commands:

- `/admin <code>`
  - Verifies admin access using `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`, unless the user ID is already listed in `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`.

- `/addannouncement`
  - Starts a guided form, or accepts Field=Value pairs.
  - Example: `/addannouncement Title=Test; Level=300; CourseCode=SWE 302; Message=Test holds Friday; Status=active`

- `/updateannouncement <AnnouncementID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates an announcement.

- `/deleteannouncement <AnnouncementID>`
  - Soft deletes an announcement by setting Status to deleted.

- `/activeannouncements`
  - Lists active announcements visible to students.

- `/addlecturer`
  - Adds a lecturer record.

- `/updatelecturer <LecturerID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates lecturer details.

- `/findlecturer <query>`
  - Searches lecturer records as an admin.

- `/addcourse`
  - Adds a course record.

- `/updatecourse <CourseCode> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates a course record.

- `/updatetimetable`
  - Adds a timetable entry through a guided Field=Value form.

- `/departmentinfo`
  - Adds or updates department info by InfoType.

## Integrations

Google Sheets API:

- Reads records from sheet tabs with short cache.
- Appends new records for add commands.
- Updates rows by key field for update commands.
- Soft deletes announcements by setting Status to deleted.
- Logs read/write failures without exposing secrets.

Telegram API:

- Uses grammY.
- Runs long polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- Clears webhook before polling to avoid webhook/getUpdates conflicts.
- Backs off and retries on polling conflicts or transient failures.

MongoDB:

- Optional.
- Collections: `memory_messages`, `admin_audit`.
- Indexes: platform/user/chat/timestamp for memory, timestamp for audit.
- No migrations are required.

## Deployment on Render

Use one Web Service or Worker service that runs:

- Build command: `npm run build`
- Start command: `npm start`

Set environment variables in Render:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`
- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`
- Optional `MONGODB_URI`

The bot uses long polling and does not require a public webhook URL.

## Troubleshooting

- If the bot exits on boot, confirm `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` is set.
- If all student queries return a Google Sheets error, confirm the spreadsheet ID and service account credentials.
- Make sure the Google Sheet is shared with the service account email as Editor.
- If admin commands fail, check `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or use `/admin your-code` after setting `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`.
- If lecturer photos do not send, confirm PhotoURL is a public HTTPS image URL. The bot will fall back to sending the link.
- Logs print environment presence booleans only, never secret values.

## Extending

Add a new command by creating a file in `src/commands/` that exports a default register function. Put shared logic in `src/features/`, `src/services/`, or `src/lib/`, not inside command files.

# Wukari SWE Bot

A Telegram implementation of the official WhatsApp-style department assistant for the Department of Software Engineering, Faculty of Computing and Information Systems, Federal University Wukari.

The bot answers student questions only from Google Sheets. It never invents announcements, fees, dates, venues, lecturer contacts, or department details.

## Features

- Official greeting for Federal University Wukari Software Engineering students.
- Student lookup commands for announcements, latest notices, timetables, courses, lecturers, and department information.
- Natural-language private chat routing for common student questions.
- Admin verification by Telegram user ID or access code.
- Admin commands to add, update, delete, and view records in Google Sheets.
- Google Sheets workbook setup with tabs and headers for Announcements, Lecturers, Courses, Timetable, and DepartmentInfo.
- Lecturer photo delivery from PhotoURL with Telegram media fallbacks.
- Optional MongoDB memory and admin audit logging.
- Render-friendly long polling with webhook cleanup and polling conflict backoff.

## Architecture

- `src/index.js` boots the bot, validates Telegram token presence, clears webhooks, sets Telegram commands, and starts polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- `src/bot.js` creates the grammY bot and registers post-command feature handlers.
- `src/commands/*.js` contains public command registration modules.
- `src/features/studentHandlers.js` routes student commands and natural-language queries.
- `src/features/adminHandlers.js` handles admin verification and guided Google Sheets write flows.
- `src/services/googleSheets.js` abstracts Google Sheets as collection-like tabs.
- `src/services/departmentRecords.js` contains active-record filtering and query matching.
- `src/services/formatters.js` formats concise student and admin responses.
- `src/lib/memory.js` optionally stores conversation turns and admin audit records in MongoDB.

## Google Sheets schema

The bot creates or connects these sheets:

1. Announcements
   - AnnouncementID, Title, Category, Level, CourseCode, Message, DatePosted, ExpiryDate, Priority, Status

2. Lecturers
   - LecturerID, FullName, Title, DepartmentRole, OfficeLocation, PhoneNumber, Email, CoursesTaught, OfficeHours, Bio, PhotoURL, Status

3. Courses
   - CourseCode, CourseTitle, Level, Semester, LecturerName, Venue, Schedule, Description, Status

4. Timetable
   - Level, CourseCode, CourseTitle, Day, Time, Venue, LecturerName, Status

5. DepartmentInfo
   - InfoType, Title, Details, ContactPerson, ContactPhone, LastUpdated, Status

Status values should normally be `active`, `inactive`, `expired`, or `deleted`. Students only see active, non-expired records.

## Setup

Prerequisites:

- Node.js 18 or newer.
- A Telegram bot token from BotFather.
- A Google Cloud service account with Google Sheets API access.
- A Google Sheet shared with the service account email as Editor.

Install dependencies:

bash
npm install


Create `.env` from `.env.sample` and fill in values:

bash
cp .env.sample .env


Required:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`: Telegram bot token.
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`: The ID from the Google Sheet URL.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`: Service account email.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`: Service account private key. Use escaped `\n` newlines if stored in one line.

Admin access:

- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`: Comma-separated Telegram numeric user IDs that are automatically admins.
- `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`: Optional secret code admins can use with `/admin code`.

Optional:

- `MONGODB_URI`: Stores conversation memory and admin audit logs. If missing, the bot runs with bounded in-memory fallback.
- `CACHE_TTL_MS`: Short Google Sheets read cache duration. Default is 30000.

Run locally:

bash
npm run dev


Production start:

bash
npm start


Build command:

bash
npm run build


## Commands

Student commands:

- `/start`
  - Shows the official department assistant greeting.
  - Example: `/start`

- `/help`
  - Lists student and admin capabilities.
  - Example: `/help`

- `/announcements [filter]`
  - Shows active department announcements, optionally filtered by level or course.
  - Examples: `/announcements`, `/announcements 300 level`, `/announcements SWE 302`

- `/latest`
  - Shows the latest active announcement or department notice.
  - Example: `/latest`

- `/timetable [filter]`
  - Shows timetable entries by level, day, course code, or today.
  - Examples: `/timetable 200 level`, `/timetable today`, `/timetable SWE 201`

- `/course <course code or title>`
  - Finds course details from the Courses sheet.
  - Example: `/course SWE 201`

- `/lecturer <name or course>`
  - Finds lecturer details and sends a photo if PhotoURL is available.
  - Examples: `/lecturer Dr Ahmed`, `/lecturer SWE 201`

- `/department <topic>`
  - Gets department identity, office, fees, contacts, HOD, venues, or general info.
  - Examples: `/department office`, `/department fees`, `/department faculty`

Admin commands:

- `/admin <code>`
  - Verifies admin access using `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`, unless the user ID is already listed in `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`.

- `/addannouncement`
  - Starts a guided form, or accepts Field=Value pairs.
  - Example: `/addannouncement Title=Test; Level=300; CourseCode=SWE 302; Message=Test holds Friday; Status=active`

- `/updateannouncement <AnnouncementID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates an announcement.

- `/deleteannouncement <AnnouncementID>`
  - Soft deletes an announcement by setting Status to deleted.

- `/activeannouncements`
  - Lists active announcements visible to students.

- `/addlecturer`
  - Adds a lecturer record.

- `/updatelecturer <LecturerID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates lecturer details.

- `/findlecturer <query>`
  - Searches lecturer records as an admin.

- `/addcourse`
  - Adds a course record.

- `/updatecourse <CourseCode> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates a course record.

- `/updatetimetable`
  - Adds a timetable entry through a guided Field=Value form.

- `/departmentinfo`
  - Adds or updates department info by InfoType.

## Integrations

Google Sheets API:

- Reads records from sheet tabs with short cache.
- Appends new records for add commands.
- Updates rows by key field for update commands.
- Soft deletes announcements by setting Status to deleted.
- Logs read/write failures without exposing secrets.

Telegram API:

- Uses grammY.
- Runs long polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- Clears webhook before polling to avoid webhook/getUpdates conflicts.
- Backs off and retries on polling conflicts or transient failures.

MongoDB:

- Optional.
- Collections: `memory_messages`, `admin_audit`.
- Indexes: platform/user/chat/timestamp for memory, timestamp for audit.
- No migrations are required.

## Deployment on Render

Use one Web Service or Worker service that runs:

- Build command: `npm run build`
- Start command: `npm start`

Set environment variables in Render:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`
- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`
- Optional `MONGODB_URI`

The bot uses long polling and does not require a public webhook URL.

## Troubleshooting

- If the bot exits on boot, confirm `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` is set.
- If all student queries return a Google Sheets error, confirm the spreadsheet ID and service account credentials.
- Make sure the Google Sheet is shared with the service account email as Editor.
- If admin commands fail, check `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or use `/admin your-code` after setting `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`.
- If lecturer photos do not send, confirm PhotoURL is a public HTTPS image URL. The bot will fall back to sending the link.
- Logs print environment presence booleans only, never secret values.

## Extending

Add a new command by creating a file in `src/commands/` that exports a default register function. Put shared logic in `src/features/`, `src/services/`, or `src/lib/`, not inside command files.

- Render-friendly long polling with webhook cleanup and polling conflict backoff.

## Architecture

- `src/index.js` boots the bot, validates Telegram token presence, clears webhooks, sets Telegram commands, and starts polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- `src/bot.js` creates the grammY bot and registers post-command feature handlers.
- `src/commands/*.js` contains public command registration modules.
- `src/features/studentHandlers.js` routes student commands and natural-language queries.
- `src/features/adminHandlers.js` handles admin verification and guided Google Sheets write flows.
- `src/services/googleSheets.js` abstracts Google Sheets as collection-like tabs.
- `src/services/departmentRecords.js` contains active-record filtering and query matching.
- `src/services/formatters.js` formats concise student and admin responses.
- `src/lib/memory.js` optionally stores conversation turns and admin audit records in MongoDB.

## Google Sheets schema

The bot creates or connects these sheets:

1. Announcements
   - AnnouncementID, Title, Category, Level, CourseCode, Message, DatePosted, ExpiryDate, Priority, Status

2. Lecturers
   - LecturerID, FullName, Title, DepartmentRole, OfficeLocation, PhoneNumber, Email, CoursesTaught, OfficeHours, Bio, PhotoURL, Status

3. Courses
   - CourseCode, CourseTitle, Level, Semester, LecturerName, Venue, Schedule, Description, Status

4. Timetable
   - Level, CourseCode, CourseTitle, Day, Time, Venue, LecturerName, Status

5. DepartmentInfo
   - InfoType, Title, Details, ContactPerson, ContactPhone, LastUpdated, Status

Status values should normally be `active`, `inactive`, `expired`, or `deleted`. Students only see active, non-expired records.

## Setup

Prerequisites:

- Node.js 18 or newer.
- A Telegram bot token from BotFather.
- A Google Cloud service account with Google Sheets API access.
- A Google Sheet shared with the service account email as Editor.

Install dependencies:

bash
npm install


Create `.env` from `.env.sample` and fill in values:

bash
cp .env.sample .env


Required:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`: Telegram bot token.
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`: The ID from the Google Sheet URL.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`: Service account email.
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`: Service account private key. Use escaped `\n` newlines if stored in one line.

Admin access:

- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`: Comma-separated Telegram numeric user IDs that are automatically admins.
- `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`: Optional secret code admins can use with `/admin code`.

Optional:

- `MONGODB_URI`: Stores conversation memory and admin audit logs. If missing, the bot runs with bounded in-memory fallback.
- `CACHE_TTL_MS`: Short Google Sheets read cache duration. Default is 30000.

Run locally:

bash
npm run dev


Production start:

bash
npm start


Build command:

bash
npm run build


## Commands

Student commands:

- `/start`
  - Shows the official department assistant greeting.
  - Example: `/start`

- `/help`
  - Lists student and admin capabilities.
  - Example: `/help`

- `/announcements [filter]`
  - Shows active department announcements, optionally filtered by level or course.
  - Examples: `/announcements`, `/announcements 300 level`, `/announcements SWE 302`

- `/latest`
  - Shows the latest active announcement or department notice.
  - Example: `/latest`

- `/timetable [filter]`
  - Shows timetable entries by level, day, course code, or today.
  - Examples: `/timetable 200 level`, `/timetable today`, `/timetable SWE 201`

- `/course <course code or title>`
  - Finds course details from the Courses sheet.
  - Example: `/course SWE 201`

- `/lecturer <name or course>`
  - Finds lecturer details and sends a photo if PhotoURL is available.
  - Examples: `/lecturer Dr Ahmed`, `/lecturer SWE 201`

- `/department <topic>`
  - Gets department identity, office, fees, contacts, HOD, venues, or general info.
  - Examples: `/department office`, `/department fees`, `/department faculty`

Admin commands:

- `/admin <code>`
  - Verifies admin access using `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`, unless the user ID is already listed in `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS`.

- `/addannouncement`
  - Starts a guided form, or accepts Field=Value pairs.
  - Example: `/addannouncement Title=Test; Level=300; CourseCode=SWE 302; Message=Test holds Friday; Status=active`

- `/updateannouncement <AnnouncementID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates an announcement.

- `/deleteannouncement <AnnouncementID>`
  - Soft deletes an announcement by setting Status to deleted.

- `/activeannouncements`
  - Lists active announcements visible to students.

- `/addlecturer`
  - Adds a lecturer record.

- `/updatelecturer <LecturerID> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates lecturer details.

- `/findlecturer <query>`
  - Searches lecturer records as an admin.

- `/addcourse`
  - Adds a course record.

- `/updatecourse <CourseCode> <Field=Value>`
  - Updates a course record.

- `/updatetimetable`
  - Adds a timetable entry through a guided Field=Value form.

- `/departmentinfo`
  - Adds or updates department info by InfoType.

## Integrations

Google Sheets API:

- Reads records from sheet tabs with short cache.
- Appends new records for add commands.
- Updates rows by key field for update commands.
- Soft deletes announcements by setting Status to deleted.
- Logs read/write failures without exposing secrets.

Telegram API:

- Uses grammY.
- Runs long polling with `@grammyjs/runner`.
- Clears webhook before polling to avoid webhook/getUpdates conflicts.
- Backs off and retries on polling conflicts or transient failures.

MongoDB:

- Optional.
- Collections: `memory_messages`, `admin_audit`.
- Indexes: platform/user/chat/timestamp for memory, timestamp for audit.
- No migrations are required.

## Deployment on Render

Use one Web Service or Worker service that runs:

- Build command: `npm run build`
- Start command: `npm start`

Set environment variables in Render:

- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`
- `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL`
- `GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY`
- `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`
- Optional `MONGODB_URI`

The bot uses long polling and does not require a public webhook URL.

## Troubleshooting

- If the bot exits on boot, confirm `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` is set.
- If all student queries return a Google Sheets error, confirm the spreadsheet ID and service account credentials.
- Make sure the Google Sheet is shared with the service account email as Editor.
- If admin commands fail, check `TELEGRAM_ADMIN_IDS` or use `/admin your-code` after setting `ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE`.
- If lecturer photos do not send, confirm PhotoURL is a public HTTPS image URL. The bot will fall back to sending the link.
- Logs print environment presence booleans only, never secret values.

## Extending

Add a new command by creating a file in `src/commands/` that exports a default register function. Put shared logic in `src/features/`, `src/services/`, or `src/lib/`, not inside command files.
